media.sourceTitle: ASL # 1 - 100 screensaver (Tip: Set YouTube to loop, select 4K resolution)
FINGERSPELLED ABC-[alphabet] USE 22 DIFFERENT HANDS SHAPE.
It is nice to meet you.

textGuide:
Extend your index finger.
Sweep it once across
your forehead.

Face two open 5-hands inward.
Pass them back and forth
through each other.

Touch an open 5-hand
to your upper chest. Pull away
while closing to a flat-O.

Form an upright P handshape.
Brush the middle fingertip
down across your lips twice.

Extend your index finger.
Stroke it downward once
from your lips.

Hold a C-hand by your mouth.
Close it to a fist and reopen
twice. Fruit and color use this sign.

Form a Y-hand at shoulder height.
Twist your wrist back and forth
a couple of times.

Form a G-hand.
Twist it at the wrist
twice.

Form a B-hand.
Rotate your forearm side to side
twice without bending the wrist.

Form a P-hand.
Shake or twist it at the wrist
twice.

Form a B-hand beside your face.
Slide its index-finger edge
down your cheek once.

Hold an open 5-hand
in front of your chin and
flutter the fingertips.
